Table 3 shows the following onset temperatures for the bare and ZrO2-coated NMC materials:

| Sample | Onset temperature (°C) |
| --- | --- |
| 0.0 wt.% ZrO2 | 231.93 |
| 2.0 wt.% ZrO2 | 251.97 |

Therefore, the onset temperature for the bare material is 231.93°C, and for the 2.0 wt.% ZrO2-coated material, it is 251.97°C.
